study type: Secondary analysis of a prospectively collected multicenter registry
outcome: peri-intubation major complications (hypotension, hypoxemia, vomiting, dysrhythmias, cardiac arrest, esophageal intubation, failed airway with cricothyrotomy)
cohort: The study participants were subjects aged over 14 years undergoing attempted emergency department intubations, extracted from the National Emergency Airway Registry.
finding: The study found an independent association between an increasing number of intubation attempts and a significantly higher risk of peri-intubation major complications in emergency department patients.
